structured.answer: I would choose Harel's "כספי (שקלי)" track: it has 0% shares and 0% foreign currency, gave 4.25% (3 years) and 3.08% (5 years), and the fee of 0.57% is under the 1.05% legal maximum. Before I move any money I'd ask my son and the bank how it compares with my deposits.
